summary: Added a deterministic runtime route inventory derived from the Express route-definition source. The CLI now emits sorted method/path/operationId entries explicitly marked implemented; duplicate, malformed, unsupported, and planned-route claims are rejected by focused tests. OpenAPI and Postman continue to compare against the same executable route source, so planned blueprint rows cannot be presented as active endpoints.

verification.notes: Ten focused inventory and artifact tests passed, including exact runtime/OpenAPI/Postman parity, duplicate/planned-route rejection, safe variables, prefix checks, and unresolved-reference rejection.
The runtime inventory CLI emitted deterministic status-labelled route entries.
OpenAPI route and schema validation passed against the executable route source.
Postman collection and safe environment validation passed against the executable route source.
Workspace syntax, contracts, and API typechecks passed.
Workspace checks and ESLint completed with zero warnings.
The serialized root suite passed with the new inventory tests registered.
The full API coverage run passed its configured thresholds.
Workspace, contracts, and API production builds succeeded.
Synthetic isolated test configuration validated without reading a real .env or contacting MongoDB.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors while backend_126 was in progress.

knownGaps: The inventory intentionally reports only executable route definitions; blueprint entries without an Express route are not claimed as implemented. Route-level authorization and ownership truth remains in each owning router/service and its tests.
A live MongoDB replica set and production credentials were not required for this internal documentation/runtime-inventory task and were not contacted.
The repository declares Node >=24 <25 while this environment ran Node 22.18.0; checked-in typecheck, lint, tests, coverage, build, and artifact gates passed locally.
